Mine uses computer vision to connect the thousands of different appearances of an image, over a thousand contexts and across any platform into one source image: where everything about that image can be collected and known. The entire ripple an image makes across the world is shown under one heading and the Mine community filters what information is most important. Our goal is to disinter mediate media consumption and interaction, which today relies on centralized platforms such as Facebook and Twitter which monetize their users and all the content that flows through them with little benefit to the communities that create that value. This is why we are building our dataset on top of the blockchain, the same technology that enabled two people to exchange a financial asset with no middleman in the case of Bitcoin. description: There is more than one American Dream. Owning your home is one of those dreams. It's been an aspiration for a long time, and we know that millions struggle to achieve it. But there are other American Dreams. Some of these dreams are about living differently than previous generations - for whom owning was everything. We may want to use our cash to start a business. We may want to experience new places. We may not have the money yet for home ownership, but still dream of living in a glorious home where we can put down roots and experience the sense of belonging. This is a new mindset. We are a community of people looking for a dream rental, and people who own properties and are looking for people who will love them. The old-school terms "landlord" and "tenant" don't apply in our world. Here, there are people who want to adopt homes for a while, and people who have wonderful residences ready for them. Our owners are not giant holding companies that own thousands of homes and view them as pure financial assets. There's a level of mutual respect and caring in our world that simply doesn't exist in the transactional, brutalist world of landlords and tenants. We manage properties for our owners, and treat the people who live there with the attention, speed and concern they deserve. And we support those who are living an ownership-free lifestyle by creating a true community everywhere we are. Our residents are connected not only to each other, but also to the local merchants, events, and institutions that give communities their unique character. Before, renters often felt like second-class citizens; with us, they are an immediate and integral part of the community. So, whether you own property and you're looking for someone to live in it and love it, or you're looking for a home where you can put down roots for however long you're planning to be there, we are the answer. Renting is the new American lifestyle. We didn't create it, but we're making it sing.

Now the company is bringing that same deep expertise to heavy equipment, developing technology that will enable contractors to improve safety, expand capabilities, and compress schedules to meet growing demand at scale. Bedrock is working alongside leading general contractors to co-develop autonomous solutions to retrofit machines like excavators, bulldozers, and loaders with a vision to make fully autonomous fleets standard on complex projects within the next five years. Abridge is purpose-built for healthcare conversations and leads the market in automatic speech recognition and clinical note generation. End-to-end ownership of the AI-powered technology stack enables Abridge to scale across a diverse range of hospital systems, care settings, specialties, and languages. Powered by Linked Evidence, Abridge is the only solution that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output. As a pioneer in generative AI for healthcare, Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems. Abridge is now implemented at a diverse set of more than 200 of the largest and most complex healthcare systems in the U.S., including UPMC, UCHealth, Kaiser Permanente, Sutter Health, Duke Health, Emory Healthcare, Johns Hopkins Medicine, Mayo Clinic, UChicago Medicine, and Yale New Haven Health.

DTEX’s InTERCEPT™ platform consolidates the essential elements of data loss prevention, user behavior analytics, and user activity monitoring in a single light-weight platform to detect and mitigate insider risks well before data loss occurs. Combining AI/ML with behavioral indicators, DTEX enables proactive insider risk management at scale without sacrificing employee privacy or network performance.

name: Grafana Labs

Grafana Labs customers include Bloomberg, Citigroup, Dell Technologies, Salesforce, and TomTom, and more than 20 million Grafana users around the world. Grafana Labs helps companies achieve their observability goals with the LGTM Stack, which features scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo) as well as extensive enterprise data source plugins, dashboard management, alerting, reporting, and security. The fully managed Grafana Cloud offering is designed to help organizations get observability up and running easier and faster, with turnkey solutions for Kubernetes and infrastructure monitoring, incident response management, load testing, application observability, and more. Grafana Labs is backed by leading investors Lightspeed Venture Partners, Lead Edge Capital, GIC, Sequoia Capital, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, and CapitalG.

name: Adaptive
description: In the construction industry, it can take anywhere from 60 to 90 days on average for contractors to be paid. This slowness has a real cost: slow contract payments raised construction costs by $273 billion in 2023. That's a 14% penalty on the total cost of construction projects, just waiting for money to move. And that's where Adaptive comes in. Adaptive helps general contractors more easily manage their finances and payments. With Adaptive, GCs can automate key workflows like transaction entry and coding, approvals, vendor compliance, and budget reporting. They can also send and receive payments digitally and all transactions have a 2-way sync with Quickbooks. This enables GCs to spend less time and money tracking their finances and helps them stay more informed on the health of their projects and business. Adaptive is filling a large gap in construction-focused financial management tools. Most construction firms today use software not built for the nuances of construction-specific financial processes, meaning they waste time and money to properly manage their books. We're excited to work with Matthew and his co-founders, Henry Bradlow and Frank Enriquez, as they scale this rapidly growing business. name: Arcee AI
description: Arcee AI provides a developer platform to pre-train, align, and continuously adapt domain-specific small language models (SLMs). Arcee AI has made training and deploying SLMs into a straightforward process using two techniques they have developed, Model Merging and Spectrum. Their technology offers vast improvements on performance at a staggering level of efficiency, in a secure end-to-end platform where the customer maintains full ownership of their models. Arcee AI's Model Merging approach allows customers to train an open source LLM on their data, then blend or “merge” that model with another open source LLM. The merged model has the brains of both input LLMs, including the domain-specific customer data, but the size and inference cost of just one input model. The merge doesn’t require any additional training, which means no GPU usage. Yet the performance of the merged model is superior to that of the two input models. Model Merge is truly a technology where 1+1 equals 3. The other approach Arcee has developed is called Spectrum, which allows for efficient training of LLMs by targeting specific layer modules that are useful, and freezing the rest. Spectrum optimizes training by 42% and addresses problems of LLMs “forgetting” previous knowledge, with no hit to performance. The Small Language Models (SLMs) resulting from these training methods greatly outperform closed source models in the enterprise. One financial services customer saw a 23% boost in benchmarks and a 96% reduction in costs. Another insurance customer boosted performance by 83% and cut costs by 89%. Arcee AI has also developed a SaaS interface, Arcee Coud, which makes Model Merging and Spectrum SLM training available with just a few clicks. This means even less technical users can build and deploy SLMs, supporting our conviction that specialized software will win in AI. CEO Mark McQuade and CRO Brian Benedict were both early commercial hires at Hugging Face and have brought with them a deep understanding of the state of AI research and the importance of developing solutions that are production-ready for the enterprise. Their third Co-Founder, CTO Jacob Solawetz, comes from YC company Roboflow (where he also worked with Mark), which has been working on computer vision problems, a subset of AI that also requires custom models for maximum performance. We are proud to partner with Arcee AI as they work to increase the utility, accessibility and performance of generative AI, so that businesses of all sizes can better serve their customers and achieve their goals. Rhapsody is cloud-based software that manages scheduling, drug inventory, and billing for veterinary practices. Boop is the companion mobile-application for consumer pet services and products.

name: Octave
description: Octave is a national behavioral health practice supporting all aspects of emotional well-being. The company offers personalized plans using the right combination of therapy and psychiatry, coaching and classes to best fit clients’ lives in a safe space that provides confidence and calm. Grounded in science, the Octave community enables clients to experience profound change that is just as measurable as it is meaningful.

name: Hidden Road
description: Hidden Road is a leading global credit network for institutions, enabling seamless credit through quantitatively-driven technology. The company’s products include prime brokerage, clearing, and financing across FX, digital assets, and derivatives.

name: Unbabel
description: Unbabel is an AI-powered, human-refined translation platform that enables multilingual customer service at scale. It transforms customer contact centers from a cost to profit center, providing automated translation, quality estimation, human expertise, and CRM integrations.

name: Rapid Robotics
description: Rapid Robotics is the creator of the first affordable robotic machine operator designed for simple machine tasks. Requiring absolutely no programming, systems integration, specialized hardware or robotics skills, the Rapid Machine Operator enables manufacturers to easily deploy a pre-trained robot in hours, moving it between tasks as needed and seeing ROI in months.

name: Merit Beauty
description: MERIT is a minimalist, clean, luxury beauty brand that creates products that are safe for the body, skin, and planet. Offering high-performing products that create a polished look in minutes, MERIT embodies founder Katherine Power’s philosophy of five-minute makeup, placing value on minimalism to bring more, with less.

name: Thankful
description: Thankful is an AI platform for customer service solutions that understands what customers want and delivers the answers they need, establishing lasting relationships through better service. The Thankful platform consists of products that enhance the customer service processes through four key elements: understanding, resolution, personalization, and intelligence. Thankful was acquired by Gladly in 2023.

name: Goop
description: Goop is a modern lifestyle company that offers contextual commerce, special real-life experiences, conversation-inspiring content, and unique products. Goop operates from a place of curiosity and non judgment and starts hard conversations, cracks open taboos, and looks for connection and resonance.

name: Hum Capital
description: Hum Capital is an intelligent credit market that helps growth companies raise capital without dilution using cutting edge financial analytics. Hum Capital believes that all companies should be empowered to see their businesses as clearly as seasoned investors do and that with the right tools, accessing institutional capital can become as predictable and efficient as buying a product on Amazon.

name: Haystack
description: Haystack is a platform that connects a company’s distributed employees, disparate systems, and top-down communications channels to a centralized hub. It is the modern employee intranet that helps make big companies feel smaller by streamlining internal communications and forging employee connections.

name: Invisible Technologies
description: Invisible is a business process automation platform that automates repetitive digital work by managing and outsourcing recurring tasks to human agents. Clients from Fortune 500 companies to startups use Invisible to run their big and small business processes more efficiently.

name: Landing
description: Landing is a network of professionally-designed, fully-furnished apartments with flexible lease terms. Landing offers its members an industry-first all-inclusive, flexible living experience. Members have access to Landing’s studios, one, and two-bedroom apartments with an on-call concierge service and a host of additional amenities.

name: Lightricks
description: Lightricks is the creator of leading photo and video creativity apps, including Facetune2, Videoleap, and Artleap. The company brings a unique blend of cutting-edge academic research, technology, and design to every product experience it creates. Lightricks’ suite of apps has over 400 million downloads worldwide and has won numerous prestigious awards.

name: BlueX Trade
description: Bluex Trade is all-in-one platform that amplifies cash flow for buyers and sellers.

name: Anycart
description: Anycart is the world’s first online grocery shopping engine connecting shoppers to local stores to quickly and easily find the groceries they need. Anycart makes shopping and meal planning easy and affordable for everyone with free delivery, no required memberships, no price mark-ups, real-time store inventory, and 1000+ shoppable recipes. Anycart was acquired by Weee! in 2022.

name: Palmetto
description: Palmetto is the leading clean technology software and fulfillment platform company. Palmetto is focused on building and deploying simplified software systems that help consumers understand their energy spend. The company continues to innovate proprietary products to reduce costs and drive widespread distribution of simple energy management solutions.

name: Semrush
description: Semrush is a leading online visibility management SaaS platform that enables businesses globally to run search engine optimization, pay-per-click, content, social media, and competitive research campaigns and get measurable results from online marketing. Semrush offers insights and solutions for companies to build, manage, and measure campaigns across various marketing channels. Semrush (NYSE “SEMR” ) had its IPO in 2021.

name: Bird
description: Bird is a transportation company guided by a shared vision: to make cities more livable through safe, sustainable electric mobility. From its first e-scooter ride in 2017 to the thousands of rides taking place every day, Bird’s award-winning custom vehicles have helped riders complete hundreds of millions of carbon-free trips in more than 150 cities around the world. Bird (NYSE “BRDS”) completed its public listing in 2021.

name: Wondery
description: Wondery is a leading podcast publisher known for character-driven, binge-worthy stories including “Dying for Sex,” “Dr. Death,” “The Shrink Next Door,” “Blood Ties,” and “Business Wars.” Wondery has gained critical acclaim and commercial success for its immersive approach to sonic, emotionally immersive storytelling, which helps listeners to “feel the story.” Wondery was acquired by Amazon in 2021.

name: Chartable
description: Chartable’s podcast analytics and attribution tools help publishers grow, and help brands & agencies understand their spend. Chartable was acquired by Spotify in 2022.

name: Versed
description: Versed is a clean drugstore skincare brand that formulates products to the highest clean standards, banning over 1,300 toxins to ensure its products are safe for human bodies and skin. Versed is also committed to reducing waste, lightening its carbon footprint, and preserving Earth’s ecosystems.

name: Pie Insurance
description: Pie Insurance is an insurtech company that is modernizing small business insurance by automating the entire experience to provide simple, trusted, and affordable coverage. Pie’s unique combination of innovative technology, sophisticated analytics, and industry expertise enables savings of up to 30% for small business owners on AM Best A- (Excellent) rated workers’ comp insurance.

name: Branch
description: Branch is a pioneer in bundling home and car insurance online. Branch utilizes innovative technology to make bundling home and auto insurance online quicker and easier than ever before. By tapping into the power of community, Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible and affordable for everyone.

name: Fetch
description: Fetch is a consumer loyalty and shopper rewards app. By working directly with hundreds of popular brands, Fetch gives shoppers access to savings on tens of thousands of products, whenever and wherever they are purchased.

name: ClosedLoop
description: ClosedLoop is a healthcare data science platform that makes it easy and affordable for healthcare organizations to use data science to improve quality and reduce costs. By providing off-the-shelf models for common healthcare use cases and automating many of the manual processes involved in traditional data science tasks, ClosedLoop allows data scientists to focus on the impactful problems that drive real value for organizations.

name: Credit Key
description: Credit Key is a B2B financial services technology company that allows merchants to offer an instant Buy Now Pay Later function that is seamlessly integrated at checkout. Credit Key’s proprietary process facilitates lightning-fast financing approval that is unique in the B2B space and proven to help merchants drive sales, revenue, and conversions.

name: Enboarder
description: Enboarder is an experience-driven platform that transforms employee onboarding into an ongoing, rich, and consistent experience, at scale. Enboarder makes new hires feel welcome and prepared and empowers HR teams and managers to create, deliver, and measure the impact of communications, helping to lay the foundation for a great culture and long-term employment.

name: Lucy
description: Lucy is the designer, manufacturer, and seller of nicotine alternative products. Lucy’s mission is to reduce tobacco-related harm to zero by creating superior nicotine products that can deliver a satisfying experience for adult tobacco users.

name: Osmosis
description: Osmosis is a medical education technology company that offers an online study platform for students in the medical field. The company creates high-quality animated videos with voiceovers, question banks, collaborative study tools, and flashcards. The system uses AI to recommend videos, questions, and other resources most relevant to students based on the concepts highlighted in their curriculum. Osmosis was acquired by Elsevier in 2021.

name: Pryon
description: Pryon is an AI company that delivers augmented intelligence for the enterprise. Driven by the inventors of core natural language technologies, the company is developing a platform that connects employees to digital transformation, extending their ability to find and use knowledge, drive workflows, and make better decisions from wherever they are.

name: Red Balloon Security
description: Red Balloon Security is a leading cybersecurity provider and research firm that specializes in the protection of embedded devices across all industries. The company’s technology defends embedded systems with a suite of host-based firmware security solutions that provide continuous runtime protection of firmware and secure embedded systems against exploitation.

name: Tapcart
description: Tapcart is a mobile commerce SaaS platform that integrates directly with Shopify, enabling brands to quickly and easily build native mobile apps for their e-commerce stores. The company is trusted by thousands of Shopify brands including Fashion Nova, Chubbies, Urban Planet, and more.

name: Asana Rebel
description: Asana Rebel is a yoga-inspired health and fitness app for anyone who wants to get in shape, have more energy, sleep better, and increase their productivity. The subscription app is available in six languages, has been featured multiple times by Apple and Google, and is rated as one of the top health and fitness apps.

name: NeueHealth
description: NeueHealth is an integrated healthcare platform that creates a personalized and affordable consumer experience by improving access to healthcare and enabling stronger relationships between patients and their providers. NeueHealth provides consumers access to personalized care teams tailored to their individual needs and gives providers the tools they need to optimize their practices and deliver valued-based care to the patients they serve. NeauHealth (NYSE “BHG”) conducted its IPO in 2021.

name: Comparably
description: Comparably is a workplace culture and compensation monitoring site that provides the most comprehensive and accurate representation of what it’s like to work at companies. Employees can anonymously rate their employers in multiple workplace culture categories, providing the public a transparent and in-depth look at the experiences different segments of workers have based on gender, ethnicity, age, department, tenure, location, education, and company size. Comparably was acquired by ZoomInfo in 2022.

name: Billie
description: Billie provides women with quality shaving supplies and premium body care products designed to make a daily routine a little more delightful and more affordable. Billie was acquired by Edgewell Personal Care Company in 2021.

name: Kheiron
description: Kheiron Medical Technologies is an applied science company focused on supporting cancer diagnostics with machine learning. Kheiron Medical’s first product Mia™ has been developed to improve the outcomes for the more than two million women diagnosed globally every year with breast cancer.

name: Embrace
description: Embrace is the only observability and data platform built exclusively for mobile. With actionable data and insights derived from every single user experience, companies can deliver better mobile experiences and make optimal business decisions by understanding the true drivers of retention and revenue.

name: Public
description: Public.com is an investing platform that lets customers build a portfolio across any fractional asset class. On Public, members can build their portfolio with any fractional asset – including stocks; ETFs, crypto & NFTs, and art collectibles – all in one place. This ownership unlocks an experience that’s contextual to one’s portfolio. With social audio programming around breaking news and insights from experts, conversations with company leaders on its Town Hall Q&A, and insights and analysis from a community of millions of other investors, creators and analysts, Public is redefining a modern portfolio and sophisticated investing experience.

name: Imperative Execution
description: Imperative Execution is a financial technology company that builds trading venues that optimize execution performance. It is a pioneer in using AI in market design and order matching. Founded by former traders, Imperative Execution is the parent company of Intelligent Cross, which operates the IntelligentCross ATS, the industry’s first smart venue to use AI in order matching to achieve high execution performance.

name: ZenBusiness
description: ZenBusiness is an online platform for business owners who want a solution to the challenges of starting, running, and growing a business. ZenBusiness uses technology and automation to provide fast and low-cost services, expert support, and a personalized dashboard that puts everything a business owner needs right at their fingertips.

name: Happiest Baby
description: Happiest Baby is a lifestyle brand dedicated to helping parents succeed in rearing and raising happy and healthy children. The company’s first product, the SNOO, uses advanced robotic technology to imitate the rhythmic sensations babies love in the womb. The SNOO rocks all night and “hears” when the baby cries, responding with just enough motion and sound to calm most crying in under a minute.

name: Emerge
description: Emerge is a digital freight marketplace connecting shippers and carriers. The platform provides access to direct capacity and live market conditions helping shippers make the strongest, most beneficial decisions when procuring domestic trucking. Emerge provides access to benchmarked rates and thousands of trusted partners to maximize cost savings.

name: Boulder Care
description: Boulder Care is a full-service digital clinic for patients struggling with substance abuse disorders. The company provides medication, resources, and support to help participants succeed on their own terms, wherever they are in their journey. Boulder Care’s program is designed by addiction medicine specialists and people with lived experiences of recovery.

name: Overtime
description: Overtime is the leading brand for the next generation of sports fans. As both a publisher and an influencer, Overtime has built an inclusive world of sports by giving a platform to its community to be seen and heard. Overtime Elite (OTE) is a transformative new sports league that offers the world’s most talented young basketball players a better pathway to becoming professional athletes and engage and inspire a new generation of fans.

name: Thirty Madison
description: Thirty Madison is a healthcare company for people living with chronic conditions. Thirty Madison’s unique care model delivers accessible, affordable care, and superior outcomes for hundreds of thousands of patients. This specialized care model is powered by the company’s proprietary platform: the technology, services, and physical infrastructure needed to provide high-quality care to an increasing number of patients.

name: Yieldstreet
description: YieldStreet is an investment marketplace that is changing the way wealth is created by providing access to asset-based investments historically unavailable to most investors. YieldStreet allows accredited investors to participate in investment opportunities with low stock market correlation across litigation finance, real estate, and other alternative asset classes.

name: Seed Health
description: Seed Health is a microbial sciences company pioneering applications of bacteria to impact human and environmental health. In collaboration with leading academic partners, Seed Health accelerates breakthrough science into live biotherapeutics and innovations for consumer health. The current pipeline includes interventions for infectious disease, allergy, and inflammatory conditions.

name: AZA Finance
description: AZA is a provider of currency trading solutions that accelerate global access to frontier markets. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, AZA is able to significantly lower the cost and increase the speed of business payments to and from frontier markets. Licensed by the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of Spain, AZA is a market-maker in every major African currency.

name: Frame AI
description: Frame AI is an early warning and continuous monitoring system that makes the customer voice an effective operational tool to inform data-driven customer experience priorities. By consolidating and enriching data across helpdesk, call center, CRM, and other channels, the company makes emerging themes that drive customer relationships and operational costs immediately actionable.

name: Axios
description: Axios is a digital media company delivering trustworthy breaking news and invaluable insights to help readers and viewers get smarter, faster across the topics reshaping our lives in politics, tech, business, media, science, and the world. Axios was created around a simple proposition: deliver the cleanest, smartest, most efficient, and trustworthy experience for readers and advertisers alike.

name: Shipt
description: Shipt is a community of Shipt Shoppers and an app that provides personal shopping and delivery. Shipt offers access to a variety of stores and product categories including fresh foods, household essentials, wellness products, office and pet supplies. Shipt was acquired by Target in 2017.

name: Data Plus Math
description: Data Plus Math is a media measurement company that works with brands, agencies, cable operators, streaming TV services, and networks to tie cross-screen ad exposure with real-world outcomes. Data Plus Math was acquired by LiveRamp in 2019.

name: Voicea
description: Voicea is the creator of a market-leading real-time solution that provides meeting transcription, voice search, and meeting highlights/action items, with robust data privacy. It helps teams have more productive and actionable meetings by turning talk into action. Voicea was acquired by Cisco in 2019.

name: Anine Bing
description: Anine Bing is a next-generation fashion brand inspired by Scandinavian simplicity and American energy and focused on everyday wardrobe essentials and investment pieces for modern women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to style. Anine Bing designs are thoughtfully sourced from the highest quality fabrications and materials, including leather, silk, linen, cashmere, and 14k gold.

name: Nom Nom
description: Nom Nom serves fresh, whole ingredient pet foods, developed by on-staff Board Certified Veterinary Nutritionists, to dogs and cats across the country. With recipes backed by science, each meal contains fresh and visible ingredients that are packed with natural vitamins and minerals. Nom Nom was acquired by Mars Petcare in 2021.

name: HealthVerity
description: HealthVerity is a technology platform that serves as the foundation for the rapid creation, exchange, and management of healthcare and consumer data in a fully-interoperable, privacy-protecting manner. Advantaged by highly sophisticated identity resolution and matching capabilities, HealthVerity is on a mission to increase transparency, forge interoperability, and activate deeper insights.

name: HopSkipDrive
description: HopSkipDrive is a safe, dependable youth transportation platform that connects schools, districts, government agencies, and families with professional, experienced CareDrivers offering their transportation services. The advanced technology platform and industry-leading operational expertise provide unparalleled flexibility, visibility, and safety.

name: Expel
description: Expel is a security operations center (SOC)-as-a-service provider committed to making security as accessible as the internet. Its SOC-as-a-service capability offers 24/7 security monitoring and response for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Expel connects to customer tech remotely through APIs, not agents, so its SOC can start monitoring a customer’s environment in a matter of hours.

name: Flutterwave
description: Flutterwave is a payments technology company that helps businesses all over the world expand their operations in Africa and other emerging markets through a platform that enables cross-border transactions via one API. The company’s key advantage is international payment processing in 150 currencies and multiple payment modes, including local and international cards, mobile wallets, bank transfers, and Barter by Flutterwave.

name: Immuta
description: Immuta is a leader in cloud data access control, empowering data engineering and operations teams to automate data governance, security, access control, and privacy protection. Data-driven organizations rely on Immuta to speed time to data, safely share more data with more users, and mitigate the risk of data leaks and breaches.

name: Partnerize
description: Partnerize is a leading provider of partnership automation solutions for global brands. The company’s Partnerize Partnership Automation Platform delivers data-driven intelligence and management tools that are essential for materially improving ROI. The Partnerize platform has won more than two dozen awards including Best Technology at the International Performance Marketing Awards.

name: Raisin
description: Raisin GmbH is a global fintech firm that provides an open banking infrastructure for the global $50+ trillion deposit market that benefits banks and savers alike. Savers receive more product choice and decision power, customer-facing institutions like banks benefit from best-in-class savings marketplace solutions for their own customers, and deposit-taking banks receive flexible, cost-effective access to diversified deposit funding. Raisin operates its own B2C platforms across Europe and the U.K. under the Raisin, WeltSparen, Savedo, and ZINSPILOT brands, and in the U.S. under the SaveBetter brand.

name: Thrive Global
description: Thrive Global is a leading behavior change tech company helping individuals, corporations, and communities improve their wellbeing and performance through a behavior change platform, storytelling, and corporate services. Thrive was founded by Arianna Huffington with the mission of changing the way humans work and live by ending the collective delusion that burnout is the price to pay for success.

name: Albert.io
description: Albert is an instructional platform that empowers teachers to unlock the potential in all learners. Albert leverages a library of practice items across math, ELA, science, and social studies and offers instant feedback and detailed explanations based on a user’s answers. Teachers can track student progress and determine areas to focus on and improve instruction.

name: Octiv
description: Octiv is a sales productivity platform designed to create efficiencies in process workflows for managing documents and assets like sales presentations, quotes, proposals and contracts. The company integrates data from CRM, CPQ, ERP, and other systems to streamline workflows, save time, and accelerate sales opportunities. Octiv was acquired by Conga in 2018.

name: Wonderbly
description: Wonderbly is an award winning publishing company that plays at the intersection of storytelling and technology. The company is on a mission to inspire boundless self-belief in children through clever and sophisticated personalization. Wonderbly is building a new class of publishing that brings millions of people into high quality products to empower them to build connections with each other. Wonderbly was acquired by Graphite Capital in 2021.

name: Inventables
description: Inventables is a 3D carving company offering intuitive software, an easy-to-use carving machine, and unique carving materials. Easel and Easel Pro, its design platforms, are the most accessible and user-friendly design software on the market. Paired with affordable 3D carving machines, makers of all abilities can produce their first project in minutes.

name: Icertis
description: Icertis is a contract intelligence company. The AI-powered, analyst-validated Icertis Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform turns contracts from static documents into strategic advantage by structuring and connecting the critical contract information that defines how an organization runs.

name: Flashpoint
description: Flashpoint is the trusted leader in actionable threat intelligence for organizations that demand coverage of threatening activity on the internet. From bolstering cyber and physical security to detecting fraud and insider threats, Flashpoint partners with customers across private and public sectors to help them rapidly identify threats and mitigate their most critical security risks. Flashpoint was acquired by Audax Private Equity in 2021.

name: Vettery
description: Vettery is a two-sided talent marketplace that aims to displace traditional executive recruiters. Each week Vettery curates a unique list of candidates, and hiring companies browse applicant profiles and request interviews directly through the platform. Vettery was acquired by Adecco Group in 2018.

name: MapAnything
description: MapAnything is the leading provider of geo-enabled field productivity solutions for field sales and services organizations. MapAnything enables customers to design optimal territories, create optimal schedules, and map optimal routes so field reps can service more accounts in less time. MapAnything was acquired by Salesforce in 2019.

name: Blinkist
description: Blinkist is a mobile learning company that transforms insights from some of the world’s best nonfiction books into powerful, mobile summaries. Blinkist delivers the main concepts of a book or topic in 15 minutes. Blinkist was acquired by Go1 in 2023.

name: Cotopaxi
description: Cotopaxi is an outdoor gear brand and Benefit Corporation with a social mission. With storefronts and an ecommerce platform, Cotopaxi designs, manufactures, and sells packs, water bottles, apparel, and gear, raising awareness and funds for various humanitarian causes through the Cotopaxi Foundation. Greycroft’s interest sold to Bain Capital in 2021.

name: Amperity
description: Amperity is a comprehensive enterprise customer data platform that provides intelligent capabilities across data management and unification, analytics and insights, and activation. Amperity helps brands get to know their customers, make strategic decisions, and take the right course of action to grow their businesses.

name: Firstleaf
description: Firstleaf is a customer-centric winery building the next generation of premium wine brands. Collaborating with famed winemakers and sourcing from vineyards around the globe, the company’s wines have won hundreds of awards, including multiple 95+ point scores, Best in Show, and Winery of the Year. Firstleaf sells through retail, restaurants, and direct-to-consumer, including via its wine club.

name: Acorns
description: Acorns is a leading micro-investing app. Its easy-to-use, mobile-first technology makes it simple for anyone to set aside and invest spare money. Acorns allows customers to automatically invest in a low-cost, diversified portfolio of exchange-traded funds offered by some of the world’s top asset managers, including Vanguard and Blackrock.

name: Thrive Market
description: Thrive Market is an online, membership-based market that delivers the highest quality, healthy and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Thrive Market carries a curation of organic and non-GMO products and offers 100+ filters and values, allowing members to shop by diet and lifestyle.

name: Static Media
description: Static Media is a modern media company that operates a content portal, destination sites, and a recommendation platform that is used by thousands of media companies. Static Media is the only content recommendation company focused on sending incremental traffic and unique visitors to its partners at scale. Its largest partners get hundreds of thousands of unique visitors every day from Static Media.

name: Dots
description: Dots is a mobile casual game studio that creates games with unique and thoughtful designs. The studio has created three mobile hits, Dots, Two Dots and Dots & Co., with Two Dots selected as an Editor’s Choice in both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Dots was acquired by Take Two Interactive Software in 2020.

name: Yeahka
description: Yeahka is a Chinese mobile payment service provider that offers mobile point of sale card payments, SMB lending, and other value‐add software to small and mid‐sized merchants in China. With extensive experience in the payments industry, Yeahka has made significant progress in key technologies in mobile payment, such as QR code payment technology, NFC payment technology, and independently developed JCVM technology. Yeahka (HKSE “9923.HK”) had its IPO in 2020.

name: Plated
description: Plated is a meal kit subscription service aimed at helping people eat better and healthier by delivering gourmet recipes and ingredients to their homes. The company sends meal-sized proportions of fresh ingredients that are pre-assembled and chef-designed to its customers. Plated was acquired by Albertsons in 2017.

name: Cuyana
description: Cuyana is a digital-first fashion brand that believes in fewer, better things. Cuyana creates apparel and accessories, designed with a classic, modern aesthetic, sourced from the world’s highest quality materials, and crafted to last a lifetime. By selling directly to customers, Cuyana is able to offer high-quality, timeless pieces at attainable prices.

name: Bread
description: Bread is a technology-driven payments company transforming the way consumers shop. Bread powers seamless payment experiences and APIs that allow retailers and partners to offer shoppers more ways to pay over time. Bread was acquired by Alliance Data Systems in 2020.

name: Azimo
description: Azimo is the leading mobile remittance provider making it easier to send money to more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. Azimo’s mission is to use technology to democratize financial services, making them affordable and available to all. With almost a million downloads and 30,000+ 5-star reviews across the App Store, Google Play and Trustpilot, Azimo provides faster, safer money transfers for everyone. Azimo was acquired by Papaya Global in 2022.

name: Button
description: Button is a mobile commerce technology company that is powering a commerce-driven internet. As the leading mobile commerce enablement platform, Button powers mobile growth for the world’s largest brands and publishers, while offering consumers more seamless, enjoyable experiences. With each action taken, brands make sales, publishers earn revenue, and consumers get exactly what they want at the tap of a button.

name: Earnest Analytics
description: Earnest Analytics is the largest provider of data analytics products providing restaurants, retailers, e-commerce companies, and investment clients with critical knowledge on consumer spending habits to power data-driven business decisions. With accurate and near real-time data on sales, orders, and other purchasing trends, Earnest Analytics enables companies to deeply understand customer habits.

name: ELOQUII
description: ELOQUII is an e-commerce destination transforming the way women sizes 14+ dress and participate in fashion. ELOQUII offers trend-driven style at accessible price points. The company debuts new and exciting trend-leading collections each month in merchandise categories including apparel, swim, wide width footwear, and accessories. ELOQUII was acquired by Walmart in 2018.

name: Farfetch
description: Farfetch is the leading global platform for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,300 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a single platform. Farfetch (NYSE “FTCH”) conducted its IPO in 2018.

name: Skimlinks
description: Skimlinks is a commerce content monetization platform. Its technology automatically monetizes product links in commerce-related content to earn publishers a share of sales they drive. Skimlinks’ platform is a one-stop solution providing the technology and the data to start and scale content commerce strategies across desktop and mobile. Skimlinks was acquired by Connexity in 2020.

name: Vidible
description: Vidible is a video management and exchange technology platform that enables buyers and sellers of digital media to manage and monetize video content across all devices. Vidible was acquired by AOL in 2014.

name: Nativo
description: Nativo is a technology platform for brand content advertising that delivers integrated ad formats and greater revenue opportunities for publishers and commerce companies, enabling brand storytelling at scale for advertisers and an improved advertising experience for consumers.

name: Boxed
description: Boxed is an online and mobile wholesale retailer that gives consumers direct-to-their-door access to all of their favorite warehouse club products. Boxed brings convenience and savings to on-the-go consumers who don’t have the time, means, or patience to shop at a brick-and-mortar big box club, all with no membership fees. Boxed (NYSE “BOXD”) completed its public listing in 2021.

name: When I Work
description: When I Work is a workforce management business that provides hourly workplaces with an integrated scheduling, time tracking, and team messaging solution that enhances the employee experience and drives better business outcomes. The company’s employee management solution ensures reliable shift coverage, engaged employees, and faster decisions that help hourly teams work better together. Greycroft’s interest sold to Bain Capital in 2021.

name: Group Nine Media
description: Group Nine is the #1 video publisher on mobile in the U.S., and its brands are built for the platforms where young people spend the majority of their time. Group Nine reaches over 80% of Americans in their 20s every month who are engaging with category-defining brands – NowThis, The Dodo, POPSUGAR, Thrillist, and Seeker. Group Nine Media was acquired by Vox media in 2022.

name: Braintree
description: Braintree is a global payments partner that provides innovative payments technology, scalable solutions, and white-glove support to help people build businesses, accept payments, and enable commerce. Merchants in more than 45 countries and regions worldwide can accept, split, and enable payments in more than 130 currencies using Braintree. Braintree was acquired by Paypal in 2013.

name: Clique
description: Clique Brands is a global media and consumer brands company that combines the power of data science with an expert editorial team to create content and products that millennial women and Gen Z girls crave. Clique Brands includes the international fashion company Who What Wear, the clean beauty company Versed, and the popular podcast Second Life. Clique was acquired by Future plc in 2022.

name: Fortumo
description: Fortumo is a global platform for payments inside mobile apps. Users can make one-click payments using Fortumo without the need for a credit card – payments are charged to their mobile operator bill instead. Fortumo was acquired by Boku in 2020.

name: data.ai
description: Data.ai combines consumer and market data with artificial intelligence (AI) to provide insights for the digital economy. Their platform includes a proprietary mobile performance score (MPS) that helps brands improve their apps and create better digital experiences.

name: WorkFusion
description: WorkFusion is a top provider of industry-specialized intelligent automation solutions that are powered by learning bots, proprietary artificial intelligence technology and advanced analytics, working together to automate a wide range of business operations, and specializing in the needs of banking, insurance and healthcare companies. Greycroft’s interest sold to Georgian in 2021.

name: JW Player
description: JW Player is the world’s largest network-independent platform for video delivery and intelligence. Media companies including Fox, VICE, Insider, and Univision, in addition to hundreds of thousands of creators of all types and sizes, rely on JW Player to deliver and monetize their content across all devices.

name: NuOrder

name: Concert Health
description: The primary care physician (PCP) is the main interface with the health system for about half of the population. PCPs often see warning signs for behaviors that adversely affect health outcome (e.g., behavioral health, addiction, etc) but don't have the time to address it with their patients. Concert Health is an outsourced service provider for those PCPs. It is a turn-key solution allowing their customers to immediately offer those services to their patients.

name: Cornerstone AI
description: Companies commonly point to data as their most valuable asset. Yet, data in healthcare is so dirty that it can only be used very narrowly. Cleaning it is a slow, expensive, mostly manual effort. CornerstoneAI is solving the fundamental problem for today’s data-intensive organizations: how to turn data into actionable insights. Cornerstone programmatically cleans customers' data and offers low-code/no-code data science enabling customers to generate insights.

name: DaylightRx
description: Analytics and workflow optimization for pharmacies.

name: Decent
description: Merged with Nice Healthcare Health insurance plays a critical central role in supporting healthy lives for all. Yet, it remains an all-too inscrutable purchase decision and user experience for so many of us. Decent offers a markedly different type of insurance that puts members first.

name: EasyHealth
description: In the US, everyday 20,000 Americans turn 65 years old and become eligible for healthcare coverage from Medicare. But there are SO many options and decisions to make - with very little clear information. EasyHealth serves as an understandable, trusted guide for a patient's health journey.

name: Goodpath
description: Goodpath is reimagining how chronic conditions are managed - delivering virtual, whole-person care that combines AI-driven personalization, predictive analytics, and a best-in-class member experience to drive better outcomes.

name: HealthCrowd
description: Acquired by mPulse Health plans and providers have a hard time engaging with patients in an effective way. HealthCrowd uses the same best practices of multivariate optimization found in ad tech to power messaging on their behalf. HealthCrowd’s analytics identify the best mode and style of communication to get messages across which are important for people's well-being.

name: HealthiPass
description: Acquired by Sphere Driven by high deductible plans and by a shift to co-insurance, patients are bearing more and more direct financial responsibility for healthcare payments. Currently, patients pay less than half they owe. HealthiPass's product allows patients to understand their obligation, pay, and create payment plans resulting in payment rates above 90%!

name: Inbox Health
description: Inbox powers the payment pipe for healthcare costs that patients directly have to pay. This is a $1 trillion unmet market need. Till now, there's been no scale infrastructure for patient pay because historically there hasn't been the need need for it. This is quickly changing as consumers are increasingly on the hook to pay for healthcare costs out-of-pocket. Inbox provides software that is intuitive and intelligent to finally serve well both the billing service providers that work with doctor practices and patients like you and me.

name: Lamar Health
description: Patients shouldn’t have to deal with further payment burden while managing conditions requiring specialty medications. Providers shouldn’t have to limit how many patients they can help due to endless administrative loops. Lamar’s AI platform elegantly eliminates the process complexity and approval opacity of prior authorization.

name: LighthouseAI
description: LighthouseAI is an AI-driven SaaS that powers supply chain regulatory compliance for the life science industry. They provide a continuous, automated solution for pharma and med tech manufacturers and distributors to seamlessly navigate the highly complex and ever-changing landscape of federal and state requirements.

name: Macro Trials
description: Macro Trials focuses on distributed clinical trials, especially in the fast growing and operationally difficult rare disease space. They provide infrastructure to reduce the complexity of distributed trials in what's dubbed as "Site Optimization Organization.” This currently includes new site activation and site monitoring. In the future, they'll build products to help design trials, business intelligence to ensure they’re being executed appropriately, recommend amendments, and power the intelligence behind synthetically powering control arms.

name: One Codex
description: Acquired by Invitae (NYSE: NVTA), now LabCorp As the price of genomic data decreases, its applications multiply. Yet, bio-informatics continues to be a bottleneck. One Codex focuses on the microbial genomics market and allows users to go from 'data to answer,' and 'answer to analysis' instantaneously. This is useful in chronic disease diagnostics, infectious disease, agriculture, and food and environmental safety.

name: PokitDok
description: Acquired by Change PokitDok offers one of the most extensive open API marketplaces available for healthcare transactions. Their APIs add new capabilities for digital health, telemedicine, and other new, disruptive care models that support value-based, patient-centric healthcare. Additionally, PokitDok was the leader in blockchain for healthcare, enabling Change to become the first healthcare IT company to deploy blockchain at enterprise scale. ‍

name: Season
description: Acquired by OpenLoop Health Season uses existing rails in food supply chains to drive proper nutrition to consumers and reduce healthcare costs. They do this while leveraging the cost-intensive aspect of the actual physical delivery of food which others have invested in already. Josh and the team are targeting a multi-billion food-as-medicine market via an insurance payer distribution channel that unlocks scale access to patients.

name: Sprockets
description: Acquired by Humanly Sprockets creates a “fit” score to best match job seekers with companies, allowing employers to level-up their talent. What this means: Sprockets tech enables employers to hire more employees who are very much like their already known top-performers. The result is better employees, higher retention, and a more productive culture.

name: StudyOS
description: Acquired by Sitero In clinical trials, missing important protocol deviations until the end of the study leads to delayed timelines and data loss. studyOS (formerly Butterfly Labs) is solving for this real-time to save study timelines and budgets.

name: Whiz.ai
description: Acquired by IQVIA (NYSE: IQV) Every part of a business is increasingly run by data. Yet, the majority of employees aren't data savvy and most companies can't afford armies of data scientists. Whiz.ai is a next generation advanced analytics company, focusing on the life-sciences vertical.

name: WootCloud
description: Acquired by Netskope WootCloud not only automatically detects and characterizes all devices on a network, but it also types devices, risk stratifies devices and, in the case of breaches, customizes the necessary remediation. WootCloud sells its technology into all industries, but the problem is more prevalent in healthcare than in other verticals.

name: Zeguro
description: Acquired by HSB Cybersecurity breaches are increasingly common. Healthcare leads all industries in the value (penalty) of a breached record. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) are especially vulnerable as they're unable to invest significantly in security. Zeguro offers SMBs a SaaS product that effectively serves as an outsourced CISO. In addition, Zeguro understands its customers' needs and tailors cybersecurity insurance for them.

name: Radiant Nuclear
description: Radiant Nuclear is redefining advanced nuclear energy through its flagship 1MW portable microreactor, Kaleidos. Designed for military bases, data centers, remote industrial sites, and grid-constrained environments, Kaleidos delivers reliable baseload power for up to 20 years using TRISO fuel and passive helium cooling. Unlike traditional nuclear projects that require decade-long development cycles, Radiant is transforming nuclear into a repeatable, factory-manufactured product that can be deployed by truck or airlift. The company is positioned at the intersection of Defense Technology and AI Infrastructure, where reliable, dispatchable power is becoming the defining constraint of growth.

name: Anduril
description: Anduril is at the forefront of modern defense innovation, leveraging advanced AI and autonomous systems to tackle complex security challenges. Their cutting-edge technology includes unmanned aerial systems, surveillance towers, and mission-command software, designed to enhance situational awareness and provide real-time actionable intelligence. By merging technology with mission-critical objectives, Anduril empowers defense agencies to safeguard democracy effectively. With a clear focus on innovation and a mission to defend democratic values, Anduril represents a compelling investment in the rapidly evolving defense tech sector.

name: CoreWeave
description: CoreWeave is a leading provider of GPU-accelerated cloud computing infrastructure, designed to meet the computational demands of modern artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and rendering workloads. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave has evolved from its origins in cryptocurrency mining to become a critical partner for businesses requiring high-performance, scalable cloud solutions. By leveraging industry-leading NVIDIA GPUs, CoreWeave offers unparalleled speed and efficiency, making it a preferred choice for developers and researchers pushing the boundaries of AI and ML innovation. CoreWeave’s unique approach to cloud computing focuses on delivering specialized, cost-effective solutions that outperform traditional general-purpose cloud providers. With data centers strategically located to maximize performance and reduce latency, CoreWeave supports a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, media, and gaming. Its rapid growth and emphasis on customer-centric solutions have solidified its reputation as an industry innovator. As the demand for GPU-powered computing continues to rise, CoreWeave’s commitment to scaling infrastructure and advancing cutting-edge technology presents a compelling investment opportunity. The company’s ability to adapt to emerging trends and cater to specialized needs ensures its position as a vital player in the AI-driven future.

name: Exowatt
description: Exowatt is addressing the defining constraint of the AI era: megawatts. As artificial intelligence accelerates global electricity demand, particularly from data centers, Exowatt provides a scalable, deployable solution that combines solar capture, long-duration thermal storage, and on-demand electricity generation in a single containerized system. Its modular platform stores heat for up to five days in a patented silicon composite battery and converts it into reliable baseload power without grid dependence. At roughly $1.5 million per megawatt and deployable in under 12 months, Exowatt offers similar stability to nuclear approaches at a fraction of the capital cost and timeline.

name: Abnormal Security
description: Abnormal Security uses cutting-edge artificial intelligence to combat advanced email threats like phishing, business email compromise (BEC), and ransomware. By analyzing user behavior and communication patterns, the platform identifies and neutralizes threats with unmatched accuracy. Its people-first approach ensures seamless integration and reduced false positives, protecting organizations’ most critical asset—their people. As the threat landscape continues to evolve, Abnormal Security’s innovative solutions position it as a leader in email security and a prime investment opportunity in cybersecurity.

name: Redwood Materials
description: Redwood Materials is redefining the future of energy with innovative recycling solutions that recover valuable materials from used batteries. By closing the loop on battery production, Redwood reduces waste and lowers the environmental impact of energy storage technologies. Their mission aligns with global sustainability goals, making them a vital player in the transition to a cleaner, greener economy. With growing demand for electric vehicles and renewable energy, Redwood Materials is a visionary company leading the charge in sustainable innovation.

name: Epirus
description: Epirus is revolutionizing defense technology with its breakthrough directed energy systems designed to neutralize drone swarms and other electronic threats. By harnessing electromagnetic pulse (EMP) capabilities, Epirus provides military, government, and commercial clients with innovative, scalable, and energy-efficient solutions for modern security challenges. Their proprietary software-defined power approach enables adaptable and precise threat mitigation, setting them apart in the evolving defense landscape. With the rise of autonomous and unmanned aerial systems (UAS), traditional defense measures struggle to keep pace. Epirus’ flagship product, Leonidas, delivers a next-generation counter-electronics solution capable of disabling drones and electronic devices with pinpoint accuracy. This game-changing technology is compact, portable, and adaptable to various defense applications, from critical infrastructure protection to battlefield operations. By focusing on rapid deployment and sustainable power efficiency, Epirus is shaping the future of electronic warfare and national security. As the demand for advanced counter-drone and EMP solutions continues to grow, Epirus stands at the forefront of this sector with its innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Its strong leadership team and commitment to pushing the boundaries of directed energy make it an attractive investment opportunity in the defense and security space.

name: Proofpoint

Their comprehensive suite includes email security, data loss prevention, and security awareness training, all designed to mitigate human-centric vulnerabilities. By focusing on the behaviors and interactions of users, Proofpoint effectively identifies and neutralizes threats such as phishing, ransomware, and insider threats. Their innovative approach ensures that organizations can safeguard sensitive information and maintain regulatory compliance in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

name: Groq

Their product suite, including GroqCard™ and GroqRack™, offers unparalleled compute speed and energy efficiency, enabling enterprises to deploy AI applications at scale. Founded by Jonathan Ross, who previously initiated Google’s Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) project, Groq continues to challenge industry norms, providing faster and more efficient solutions for complex computational tasks.

As data continues to grow in scale and complexity, Databricks offers an essential solution for enterprises aiming to stay competitive.

name: Abridge
description: Physicians today face a significant challenge with documentation, usually spending up to 50% of their time on administrative tasks. Dr. Shiv Rao, a UPMC-trained practicing cardiologist, saw this issue firsthand and found a way to solve this massive pain point. Abridge is building the generative AI layer of healthcare, streamlining care delivery workflows and enhancing patient outcomes without the need for human intervention.

name: Accompany Health
description: Millions of eligible Americans still struggle to access basic healthcare services due to challenges like booking appointments or finding transportation. We believe Accompany Health is the solution to this dilemma. The core of Accompany Health’s model – aligning business incentives with better patient outcomes – has the potential to revolutionize not just the health but also the lives of patients everywhere.

name: Aiven
description: Organizations of all sizes are moving to the cloud and leveraging open source software as the backbone of their data infrastructure. While larger companies have the resources and expertise to manage these enterprise deployments internally, most companies require some level of third-party support to effectively utilize open source. Aiven democratizes access to the latest open source technologies by offering fully-managed services for popular open source projects like Apache Kafka and Cassandra, Elasticsearch, M3 and PostgreSQL in the public cloud.

name: Ajaib
description: With impressive GDP growth and a rapidly expanding middle class, Southeast Asia is fertile ground for a new generation of fintech investors. Yet in Indonesia, investing has long been considered an activity for the rich and privileged, with stock market access limited to all but high net worth individuals. Ajaib is on a mission to change that with a foundational, forward-thinking financial platform that’s bridging the stock penetration rate between Indonesia and the rest of the world. Founders Yada Piyajomkwan and Anderson Sumarli are forging a path to financial flexibility for emerging economies by providing stock market access and education to first-time investors, a group that has traditionally been neglected. Stock trading is just the first of many services Ajaib can provide to this fast-growing demographic, with its mobile-native, technology-first platform offering huge expansion potential for supporting online banking services, FX, crypto trading and more. With greater financial freedom across Southeast Asia in their sights, the Ajaib team is just getting started.

name: Aledade
description: It’s no secret that the U.S. healthcare system suffers from wasteful spending and suboptimal outcomes. Traditionally, the sicker patients get, the more profitable they become for healthcare providers—a system that has long created misaligned incentives by rewarding the treatment of disease rather than its prevention. Through its proprietary technology platform and local, hands-on support teams, Aledade promotes value-based care programs in which compensation is aligned with quality—as opposed to quantity—of care. By partnering with primary care practices to build and lead Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), the startup is helping deliver better patient care, improved health for overall populations, and reduced care costs. As beneficial to doctors as it is to patients, Aledade’s model is paving the way for a stronger, healthier healthcare system and society as a whole.

name: Amplitude
description: Today’s product teams are increasingly recognized as critical drivers of revenue. While the role and prominence of product teams have evolved over the years, the same can’t be said for their toolsets. Forced to use unwieldy or archaic tools—often intended for marketing organizations—product teams are in desperate need of better technology that’s built for their specific needs. That’s where Amplitude comes in. Built explicitly for the product team and CPO, their next-generation analytics platform focuses directly on user behavior to help companies build better products. By leveraging NOVA, its proprietary engine optimized to answer complex queries over aggregated sets of users, the enterprise platform enables product teams to efficiently analyze the information most relevant to their businesses. A solution beloved among cutting-edge start-ups and Fortune 500s alike, Amplitude is a market-defining B2B SaaS company in the emerging category of product analytics software.

name: Anomali
description: A threat intelligence platform that identifies cyber threats and facilitates trusted threat sharing

name: Anthropic
description: Anthropic delivers the kind of breakthrough moment that reminds us why we fell in love with technology. Many of us remember the first time we held an iPhone. Using Claude feels like that. Claude has quickly become indispensable for drafting, building, researching, and making sense of complex data. Not because it is novel, but because it is genuinely useful. What makes Anthropic special is the combination: a world-class team that expands the frontier of AI, transforms that capability into elegant products, and brings them to market in a way enterprises trust. We believe Anthropic will be an era-defining company.

name: Appcharge
description: Appcharge is redefining the economics of gaming by giving publishers ownership of their players, their profits, and their paths to growth. With lightning-fast traction, deep customer trust, and a platform that feels invisible yet indispensable, Appcharge is becoming the infrastructure layer for first-party payments. The team has a rare combination of domain fluency and executional intensity required to lead this shift. In an era where power is moving back to creators, Appcharge is the engine behind that movement.

name: AppDynamics
description: A leader in application intelligence for software-defined business

name: Attentive
description: Attentive’s suite of software tools breathes fresh life into marketing communication by helping top brands build a list of opt-in mobile messaging subscribers, automatically send highly personalized messages, power two-way conversations and measure the impact of each message. Less crowded than other channels and preferred by key demographics, messaging promises higher click-through rates and strong, immediate ROI. By presenting a fundamentally better way to engage, Attentive is creating a new reality of welcome and relevant dialogue between brands and consumers.

name: Baseten
description: People expect personalized, intuitive experiences powered by the latest AI models. But getting these models into production, where they can deliver sustained business value, is notoriously complex. Baseten's inference engine enables companies to easily and securely deploy models in production, saving engineering time by handling complexities like GPU management in the cloud and reducing cold starts. Baseten ensures AI scalability with a focus on both low latency and high reliability.

name: Brex
