description: Aspect Biosystems combines 3D bioprinting, therapeutic cells, and computational design to create implantable tissue therapeutics. The platform aims to deliver a new class of regenerative medicine, beginning with metabolic and endocrine diseases such as diabetes.

name: Attuned Intelligence
description: Attuned Intelligence believes getting healthcare help should feel human, no matter how busy the phones get. That's why they built a Voice AI Agent that answers every call instantly, speaks the caller's language, and connects them to the right care safely — while giving frontline teams the support they deserve.

name: CentML
description: CentML optimizes AI model performance and reduces compute costs for machine learning workloads. The company was acquired by Nvidia in 2025.

name: Chemix
description: Chemix uses AI to design and optimize next-generation battery chemistries, accelerating material discovery for electric vehicles and the energy transition.

name: Cinder
description: Cinder is the industry-leading trust and safety operations platform, helping organizations combat AI-powered abuse, fraud, and harmful content at scale. Founded by former Meta employees, Cinder provides mission-critical infrastructure protecting platforms including OpenAI, Spotify, and Depop from digital threats and manipulation. Cinder's platform automates threat detection, investigation, and response workflows through AI-powered agentic safety capabilities. Radical Ventures led the company's $41M Series B in 2026, bringing total funding past $60M alongside Accel, M12, and Y Combinator.

name: Cohere
description: Cohere ensures organizations own their intelligence layer instead of renting it. When only a few big companies control the technology, people have little ability to shape how their AI systems work or evolve. Founded in 2019, Cohere is a security-first enterprise AI leader that empowers organizations to transition from experimental AI to reliable, secure, and fully controlled production systems. By building powerful foundation models and end-to-end solutions, Cohere partners with enterprises and public-sector agencies worldwide to solve real-world business problems. Their approach prioritizes maximum privacy and deployment flexibility—whether across clouds, private environments, or on-premises—ensuring that organizations in highly regulated industries maintain absolute ownership over their data and infrastructure.

name: Covariant
description: Covariant builds AI that gives robots the ability to see, reason, and act in the real world, bringing dexterous automation to warehouses and supply chains.

name: Crusoe
description: Crusoe Energy is a leading developer of AI-optimized data center infrastructure, building the physical foundation that powers today's AI revolution. The company specializes in constructing large-scale, purpose-built data centers designed specifically for AI workloads. Crusoe's competitive advantage lies in its unparalleled access to energy resources, deep vertical integration, and supply chain expertise — enabling the company to build gigawatt-scale AI data centers faster and at larger scales than competitors. The company has partnered with several of the world's largest technology companies, including OpenAI, for whom Crusoe is developing the massive 'Stargate' data center in Abilene, Texas.

name: Cyera
description: Cyera is an AI-native data security platform that helps enterprises discover, classify, and protect sensitive data across hybrid cloud environments. Its agentless deployment scales to petabytes of data with 95% classification accuracy, letting organizations embrace AI while keeping their data secure. Founded in 2021 by veterans of Israel's Unit 8200, Cyera has grown to a $9B+ valuation with over $460M raised, making it a leading innovator in the fastest-growing category of enterprise security.

name: DatologyAI
description: DatologyAI automates the curation and selection of training data to improve AI model performance. They help companies train better models with less data and less compute.

name: Decart
description: Decart is an AI research lab building real-time world models and ultra-optimized infrastructure that lets AI systems run at the speed of reality. Its foundational models include Lucy, powering immersive experiences that respond in under 30 milliseconds, and Oasis, built for physical AI and robotics. Founded in 2023 by alumni of Israel's Unit 8200, Decart combines deep systems-optimization expertise with frontier generative AI research. Radical Ventures led the company's $300M Series B in 2026 at a $4B valuation.

name: Delphina
description: Delphina is an LLM-powered copilot for data science that accelerates how teams build, deploy, and improve predictive AI models.

name: Discovery Loop
description: Discovery Loop is a public benefit company automating the scientific method, deploying AI systems that run thousands of experiments in parallel — proposing hypotheses, executing tests, analyzing results, and iterating without human intervention. The team is starting with the automation of machine learning research, then intends to take on challenges across engineering, medicine, materials science, and clean energy — bringing together deep expertise in silicon, foundation models, and large-scale distributed computing.

name: Emerald AI
description: Emerald AI develops software that turns energy-intensive AI data centers into flexible grid assets, cutting power draw during peak demand without sacrificing compute performance.

name: Etched
description: Etched builds frontier inference clusters designed to make AI inference dramatically faster, cheaper, and more abundant. Through deep co-design across the entire stack, Etched's rack-scale systems deliver best-in-class throughput and latency, powered by two novel computing technologies: Low Voltage Inference (LVI) and Cluster Scale Memory (CSM).

name: Firsthand
description: Firsthand lets publishers and brands build and distribute their own AI agents to consumers while retaining full control over their data and content.

name: General Magic
description: General Magic rebuilds the operating layer of insurance with AI agents that handle the full brokerage workflow — customer conversations, underwriting, and compliance. The platform integrates directly into existing broker management systems, cutting quote times from 30 minutes to under three.

name: Generalist
description: Generalist is a frontier AI robotics company building general-purpose embodied AI models that let robots master complex physical tasks. Its GEN-1 model achieves 99% reliability on dexterous manipulation — versus 64% for prior approaches — with 3x faster execution and emergent improvisational capabilities. Founded in 2024 by Pete Florence (former DeepMind robotics lead), Andy Zeng (co-author of PaLM-E), and Andrew Barry (Boston Dynamics), Generalist raised a $400M Series A led by Radical Ventures in 2026 at a $2B valuation.

name: Genesis Molecular AI
description: Genesis Molecular AI unifies AI and biotech, pairing proven drug developers with an advanced small-molecule discovery platform. By bringing together drug developers, AI researchers, and software engineers, Genesis uses machine learning across the discovery pipeline to design and advance transformative new therapies faster than traditional methods allow.

name: Hebbia
description: Hebbia's AI platform is capable of reading and comprehending the untouched universe of unstructured, private data. Its 'neural search' enables a user to ask questions using natural language, with Hebbia searching all available data to provide answers immediately and accurately. From broad market research to targeted information extraction, Hebbia automates diligence workflows, acting as an AI Analyst and instantly surfacing deal points even humans miss.

name: Inherent
description: Inherent is a London-based AI research lab building general-purpose inventive AI to accelerate scientific discovery, applying recursive self-improvement to both its models and its research organization.

name: Intrepid Labs
description: Intrepid Labs, a University of Toronto spinout, uses an AI-driven robotic platform to autonomously design and test drug formulations — optimizing delivery format and dosing for better patient outcomes.

name: Latent Labs
description: Founded by a key architect of DeepMind's Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold2, Latent Labs builds AI foundation models that make biology programmable through de novo protein design.

name: Mantic
description: Mantic is a world-class technical team on a mission to solve the next AI grand challenge: predicting global events with superhuman accuracy and deploying this capability to power radically improved decision-making in business and government.

name: Mosaic
description: Mosaic is an AI-driven deal-modeling platform that generates financial models and LBO analyses for investment professionals. By automating the infrastructure of deal modeling — linking, calculations, and formatting — Mosaic delivers near-instantaneous, rules-based deal math with transparent, downloadable Excel outputs, freeing investors to focus on judgment rather than mechanics.

name: Muon Space
description: Muon Space builds and operates full-stack satellite systems that deliver mission-grade Earth-observation data to organizations without space expertise. From wildfire detection to climate resilience, Muon designs, launches, and manages custom satellite constellations end-to-end, turning raw orbital sensing into actionable planetary intelligence.

name: Nabla Bio
description: Nabla Bio combines generative AI with large-scale, human-relevant testing to turn drug development from trial-and-error into an engineered, designable process. The company is beginning with antibodies against the hardest, most intractable targets in medicine — designing therapeutics from first principles rather than discovering them by chance.

name: OffDeal
description: OffDeal is an AI-native investment bank for small and medium-sized businesses, using proprietary data and AI agents to run the M&A process at scale. The platform matches sellers with the right buyers and automates the workflow that has historically made SMB dealmaking slow and expensive — bringing institutional-grade advisory to a long-underserved market.

name: Orbital Industries
description: Orbital Industries uses generative AI to discover and design new materials, replacing slow lab trial-and-error with its foundation model to develop technologies for the energy transition.

name: Outset
description: Outset is an AI-moderated research platform that runs hundreds of qualitative interviews simultaneously across languages and geographies. Combining conversational AI with behavioral and emotional intelligence, Outset lets researchers hear, see, and understand their customers at a scale and speed that traditional one-on-one studies can't match.

name: P-1 AI
description: P-1 AI is building an AI engineer for the physical world named Archie, which automates design work for complex physical systems. Archie uses multi-physics reasoning across domains like data-center cooling, industrial systems, and aerospace.

name: Periodic Labs
description: Periodic Labs is building scientific superintelligence to accelerate discovery in the physical sciences. The company’s platform combines frontier AI models, physics-based simulations, and autonomous robotic laboratories to create a closed-loop system where AI scientists can generate hypotheses, design experiments, and learn from outcomes. Founded by Liam Fedus, who co-created ChatGPT at OpenAI, and Dogus Cubuk, who led materials AI at Google DeepMind, Periodic Labs’ mission is to build the technology infrastructure for scientific discovery driven by AI.

name: Pixxel
description: Pixxel operates a constellation of hyperspectral imaging satellites that monitor the health of the planet, delivering AI-powered geospatial analysis for agriculture, energy, and the environment.

name: Pocket Health
description: PocketHealth gives patients ownership of and access to their medical imaging while providing hospitals with modern image-sharing and management tools.

name: Prepared
description: Prepared builds an AI platform for 911 call centers, delivering real-time transcription, instant multilingual translation, and intelligent dispatch support to accelerate emergency response.

name: Prime Intellect
description: Prime Intellect builds decentralized infrastructure for training, evaluating, and deploying frontier AI models at scale. Its full-stack platform lets organizations train and continuously improve their own agentic AI systems — without relying on frontier labs — by aggregating globally distributed compute and providing tools for reinforcement learning, evaluation, and inference serving. The company's fault-tolerant architecture trains across unreliable nodes with low network bandwidth, achieving up to 96% compute utilization across networks spanning multiple continents. Customers including Ramp and Zapier use Prime Intellect to train models optimized for their specific workflows, achieving superior performance at lower cost than frontier models. Radical Ventures led the company's $130M Series A in 2026.

name: Promise Robotics
description: Promise Robotics combines AI and robotics to transform the construction industry through automated manufacturing, building an industrial production system for sustainable and affordable housing.

name: Reka
description: Reka develops multimodal AI models that understand text, images, video, and audio, delivering enterprise-grade models with privacy and security built in.

name: Ribbon

name: Ricursive Intelligence
description: Ricursive Intelligence automates semiconductor design with reinforcement learning, compressing chip development from years to weeks — where better-designed chips enable more powerful AI in a compounding loop.

name: Serval

name: Signal 1
description: Signal 1 embeds AI-driven insights into hospital workflows, helping health systems address surgical backlogs, staffing shortages, and clinician burden while improving patient outcomes.

name: Slingshot AI

name: Prime Security
description: Prime Security brings automated product security reviews to every software release. Prime’s platform ingests project context, starting with a PRD or planned engineering tickets, and performs a comprehensive product security review, identifying security, privacy, and compliance risks. After presenting these findings, Prime makes suggestions on how development should proceed to minimize security risk.

Their AI customer service agent Fin is the market leader, handling millions of resolutions across a range of complexity with their proprietary AI. The Intercom Customer Service Suite combines Fin with their next-gen Helpdesk so their users can provide best-in-class customer service.

name: CodeRabbit
description: CodeRabbit's AI-powered code review lets engineers ship code faster. Their AI code review agent slots seamlessly into the developer workflow. Integrated directly into GitHub and other version control systems as well as the IDE, it automatically reviews every pull request, surfaces issues, and provides actionable, line-level feedback. The review is context-aware, truly understanding the broader context of a codebase to identify subtle logic errors, spot security vulnerabilities, and suggest improvements that align with architectural patterns and company standards.

name: Hello Patient

Gone are the days of patients calling in at their time of need only to get stuck in a queue and left on hold. Hello Patient’s AI agent works 24/7 to answer questions, schedule appointments, and more. It’s a win-win: patients get care faster and healthcare practices grow their top line.

name: Inspiren
description: Inspiren supports care communities in providing proactive, precision care with data. Their technology combines hardware and software to give care teams a real-time view of resident behavior they can use for both tactical care delivery and long-term planning. The end result? Safe residents, happy staff members, and financially prosperous senior living communities.

It’s modern, collaborative, and intuitive enough to drive adoption beyond the CFO’s office, while striking the perfect balance between enterprise-grade functionality and the ease of use for a midmarket company. And, as the connective tissue for the finance org, FP&A is the natural hub for AI in finance, where automation, intelligence, and collaboration can drive the most significant impact.

Permit.io provides developers with all of the infrastructure and tools to manage authorization, solving access control for the final time.
